description: The tenant-bound quote detail route and the retired bare-id route. Run from apps/server: npx vitest run test/commerce-quote-visibility.integration.test.ts src/core/auth/public-surface.spec.ts --reporter=json --outputFile=.proof/r0-04-vitest.json against a migrated local database and REDIS_URL, then node ../../scripts/proof-admission/evaluate.mjs --manifest ../../scripts/proof-admission/manifests/quote-detail-route.json --report .proof/r0-04-vitest.json. JOINED ROWS (review finding ST-R004-1, fixed): the quote row is bound to the path tenant, and so is the contact it joins. The case 'ST-R004-1 (fixed)' replaces the former 'OPEN DEFECT ST-R004-1 reproduced' case, which pinned the defect: a contactId of another tenant on quote create or patch answers 404, byte-identical to an unknown contact, with no Quote row written or changed (R0-27 review ST-27-2, 76e1c59d), and the operator include serves a contact only of the quote's own tenant, so a legacy row already joined to a foreign contact reads contact null (R0-04 / R0-CMF3-QUOTE-CONTACT-TENANT, proved by scripts/proof-admission/manifests/quote-contact-tenant.json).
